property.name: iconName
property.label: Icon Name (file without .svg)
property.description: Icon file name within the Static Resource (e.g. 'fertilizante').

property.name: iconAlt
property.label: Icon Alt Text
property.description: Accessibility alternative text for the icon (if empty, uses the Header).

property.name: bodyText
property.label: Body Text
property.default: Content description. This is the body of the text.

property.name: textColor
property.label: Text Color
property.description: Text color (HEX, RGB or CSS name)

property.name: maxTextWidth
property.label: Max Text Width (px)
property.description: Maximum text width to avoid very long lines (0 for no limit)

property.name: horizontalGapRem
property.label: Horizontal Gap (rem)
property.description: Horizontal space between icon and text, in rem
